messages:
sofia: Notifying folks 11:18 UTC - wee seeing increased replication lag in embed-store in us-east1 causing transient 502/504 for embedding requests. Spike started ~11:10 UTC. Opening thread.
li: Observed pattern: a config tweak to compaction windows earlier caused many nodes to compact at same time -> IO pressure -> replication backlog.
rahul: Mitigations underway: 1) throttled compaction on canary nodes, 2) temporarily scaled embed-store read replicas + added leader priority to rebalance replica catch-up, 3) adjusted client retry budget to avoid request storms. Early metric: 5xx rate dropped from 1.6% -> 0.4% in last 10m.
emily: Customer impact: small set of self-serve customers in us-east receiving errors and increased latency. Draft support note: https://redwood.internal/support/notes/embed-repl-us-east1 (please sign off).
sofia: Rolling back compaction config change is scheduled if the throttles don't bring steady state in 20m.
li: Quick snippet we ran to throttle compaction on the canary nodes: ```kubectl patch sts embed-store-canary -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"embed-store","env":[{"name":"COMPACTION_RATE_LIMIT","value":"200"}]}]}}}'``` 
rahul: ops-bot: triggered leader re-election on nodes eu1/3/us-east1-c, job id: reelect-2261. Monitoring catch-up progress.
status-bot: Live status: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2261234567 (contains realtime charts)
emily: Action items: li (confirm compaction throttle is stable), rahul (validate replica catch-up by 12:00 UTC), sofia (coordinate customer comms + update status page). Postmortem owner: emily. Schedule tentative postmortem slot tomorrow 16:00 UTC.
sofia: Current status: P2, partial customer impact narrowed to us-east1 embedding traffic. Keeping the incident channel open for another 60m. :eyes:
